title: decode_utf8_chunk split-sequence handling is correct and must stay
description: decode_utf8_chunk correctly handles multi-byte UTF-8 sequences split across adjacent HTTP chunks. The three cases (valid, incomplete, definitively-invalid) map exactly to std::str::Utf8Error semantics. The incomplete-head retention (drain only valid prefix, leave head for next chunk) is the only correct behavior — dropping the head would corrupt codepoints. A contributor might suggest simplifying to String::from_utf8_lossy, which replaces incomplete sequences with U+FFFD replacement characters, breaking any codepoints split at chunk boundaries. The current design is correct. The test suite has six targeted test vectors covering all three cases including the exact chunk-split scenario (split_sequence_completed).
